name: Nigeria
notes: Identifier formats other than the NIN are not published in a source the pack cites: every other scheme is free text.
The state list is verified against section 3 of the Constitution; the ISO 3166-2 codes are read from a secondary copy of the ISO table and are unconfirmed.
No local government area list is bundled: the local government area is free text.
Democracy Day moved from 29 May to 12 June with the Public Holidays (Amendment) Act 2019; the Act's text was not fetched, so the dates of the change come from news reports and are approximate.
Boxing Day is not named in the Schedule as printed in the Laws of the Federation; it is declared by the Federal Government and is kept as a draft.
The Muslim festivals are listed for 2026 only, the year whose Ministry of Interior declarations the pack cites; Id el Fitr and Id el Kabir each carry the two days declared.
The Act gives a holiday that falls on a weekend no day in lieu; the Federal Government sometimes declares one by notice, and the pack does not model those notices.
The PAYE due day is stated by the FCT Internal Revenue Service; other states' services are assumed to follow it. The pension and NSITF due days are unconfirmed.

statutoryReturns.authority: State Internal Revenue Service of the state of employment (FCT-IRS in the Federal Capital Territory)
statutoryReturns.note: Stated by the FCT Internal Revenue Service: PAYE is remitted by the 10th of the month after deduction. Other states' services are assumed to follow it; confirm each state's own notice.

statutoryReturns.authority: Employee's Pension Fund Administrator, supervised by the National Pension Commission
statutoryReturns.note: The Commission cites the Pension Reform Act 2004 as remittance within 7 days of the day the employee is paid, and a secondary source gives 7 working days under the 2014 Act. The due rule here cannot say 'after the salary is paid'; it takes the seventh working day of the following month, which assumes salary is paid at month end.
From a secondary source; the Fund's page cited names the monthly contribution but no due day was found. Confirm against the Employees' Compensation Act 2010 and the Fund's notices.
